houses.name: Artcurial
houses.note: Every Artcurial sale in the Hermes Vintage and Luxury Bags series, harvested sale by sale from their open JSON API. Premium-inclusive prices are published.

houses.name: Bonhams
houses.note: Cross-sale search over the public Typesense lot index. Bonhams publishes both hammer and premium-inclusive prices; the premium-inclusive figure is used.

houses.name: Christie's
houses.note: Global cross-sale search over every past Christie's lot. Realised prices are published in full and include buyer's premium.

houses.name: Heritage Auctions
houses.note: Harvested through a signed-in browser session: Heritage omits realised prices server-side for anonymous visitors and blocks non-browser clients. Prices are premium-inclusive and quoted in USD.

houses.name: Poly Auction Hong Kong
houses.note: Every archived Poly Auction Hong Kong handbag saleroom, harvested per sale so unsold lots stay visible. Premium-inclusive prices are published in HKD.

houses.name: Sotheby's
houses.note: Full catalogue index via Algolia, priced per lot via the public GraphQL gateway. Sotheby's withholds the realised price on a meaningful share of lots; those are reported as 'result withheld', never as unsold.
